summary.text: JØDISK BO- OG SENIORSENTER STI is a foundation registered in Oslo, founded 1987-09-21. JØDISK BO- OG SENIORSENTER STI is registered for housing for the elderly (aldersbolig). It was previously named STIFTELSEN JØDISK ALDERSBOLIG until 2001-06-26. Its main industry code is 87.102: nursing care activities in nursing homes. The register shows 39 employees and 1 registered workplace. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 22 504 668 NOK and the annual result was 45 152 NOK; operating income was down from 23 450 060 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 1 034 950 NOK in 2024 to 45 152 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 951 051 NOK in 2024 to 996 203 NOK in 2025. The registered employee count went from 40 on 2025-11-13 to 39 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
